No `__set__`; default object `__set__` puts value in instance.__dict__ directly. So `DeferredAttribute` only handles `__get__`; setattr stores enum without conversion.

Fix: override `__set__` in `DeferredAttribute` to extract `.value` if value is enum member, or convert in model `__init__` before `_setattr`. Prefer adding `__set__` to `DeferredAttribute` converting enum type to value.
